items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Titled sections exist as a 6-step wizard (h2 'Personal details', 'Job and contract', 'Bank and tax information', 'Emergency contact', 'Documents') and every field has a label above it (.field label display:block). But fields sit in a multi-column grid (div.grid.sm:grid-cols-6 with sm:col-span-2/3), e.g. First/Last name side by side in first.png, so it is not a single column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required fields get a red asterisk via .req::after, consistently. Optional fields (Preferred name, Gender, Alternate phone) are unmarked, but no legend such as '* required' states the convention. Only the document list says Required/Optional.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Types are right (type=email, type=tel, type=date). Widths are not content-sized: date, ZIP (sm:col-span-2) and routing are each a third of the row (about 250px), SSN is col-span-3 (half the row), and email and phone are half-row.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: #saveDraft 'Save draft' handler writes to localStorage with no call to validateStep. The status text updates to 'Draft saved at ...'. Bank account and SSN are deliberately left out of drafts.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: The action footer is a plain in-flow div (flex ... border-t px-6 py-4) with no sticky or fixed positioning. 'Save draft' sits in the page header and also scrolls away. There is no Cancel button. The primary label is 'Continue' or 'Submit onboarding'. Buttons are not disabled.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: The blur listener checks only non-empty values (e.target.value && check), so empty required fields are not flagged on blur. validateStep focuses the first invalid field (first.focus()), but the #banner is only the text 'Please correct the highlighted fields before continuing.' with no list and no links to fields. Error messages are not tied to inputs with aria-describedby.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: There is no beforeunload handler anywhere in the script.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Text reads 'PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each'. renderDocs lists file name and size, with a Remove button (data-rm) and Upload/Replace controls. The file input is a real input[type=file].sr-only inside a label, so it is focusable by keyboard. Weaknesses: no visible focus style on the label, the size error uses alert(), and file type is only enforced by the accept attribute.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: #doneMsg text is 'Linh Tran has been added as ... in Finance, starting ...', which names the employee. But #done has no role=status, role=alert, aria-live or focus move, so it is not announced.

notes: Audit score 90 (one contrast error: the '/' separator in the header, 1.48:1). The page uses a wizard with a Completion percentage bar (progress by step, not decorative), has no Cancel, and shows the Review step's masked sensitive values. The 'N' tile is a logo mark, not an initials avatar, so it is not counted. Indigo accent on white, no gradients or glass, radii 4 to 8px. Few template tells. The main failures are interaction details: no sticky bar, no error summary with links, no beforeunload, no aria-live on success.
